analytics_steps_left_check.name: analytics_steps_left_check
analytics_steps_left_check.value:
("analytics_steps"."left_at" IS NULL AND "analytics_steps"."left_on" IS NULL AND "analytics_steps"."seconds" IS NULL AND "analytics_steps"."decision" IS NULL AND "analytics_steps"."decided_by" IS NULL)
          OR ("analytics_steps"."left_at" IS NOT NULL AND "analytics_steps"."left_on" IS NOT NULL AND "analytics_steps"."seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "analytics_steps"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "analytics_steps"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL
              AND "analytics_steps"."left_at" >= "analytics_steps"."entered_at" AND "analytics_steps"."seconds" >= 0)

analytics_steps_reason_check.name: analytics_steps_reason_check
analytics_steps_reason_check.value:
CASE WHEN "analytics_steps"."decision" IN ('SEND_BACK', 'REJECT')
        THEN "analytics_steps"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "analytics_steps"."reason_key" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "analytics_steps"."reason" IS NULL AND "analytics_steps"."reason_key" IS NULL
      END

scheduled_jobs_finished_check.name: scheduled_jobs_finished_check
scheduled_jobs_finished_check.value: "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" IS NULL OR ("scheduled_jobs"."last_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" >= "scheduled_jobs"."last_started_at")

scheduled_jobs_tick_check.name: scheduled_jobs_tick_check
scheduled_jobs_tick_check.value: "scheduled_jobs"."last_tick" IS NULL OR "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" IS NOT NULL

money_actions_cancel_check.name: money_actions_cancel_check
money_actions_cancel_check.value:
CASE WHEN "money_actions"."is_cancelled"
        THEN btrim(coalesce("money_actions"."cancel_reason", '')) <> '' AND "money_actions"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "money_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "money_actions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL AND "money_actions"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "money_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
      END

order_settlements_ack_check.name: order_settlements_ack_check
order_settlements_ack_check.value:
CASE WHEN "order_settlements"."overspend_ack_by" IS NOT NULL
        THEN "order_settlements"."overspend_ack_at" IS NOT NULL AND btrim(coalesce("order_settlements"."overspend_ack_comment", '')) <> ''
        ELSE "order_settlements"."overspend_ack_at" IS NULL AND "order_settlements"."overspend_ack_comment" IS NULL
      END

order_actions_reason_check.name: order_actions_reason_check
order_actions_reason_check.value: "order_actions"."reason" IS NULL OR char_length("order_actions"."reason") BETWEEN 5 AND 500

orders_finish_reason_check.name: orders_finish_reason_check
orders_finish_reason_check.value: ("orders"."progress" IN ('DONE_SHORT', 'NOT_BOUGHT')) = ("orders"."finish_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("orders"."finish_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("orders"."finish_reason") BETWEEN 5 AND 500)

orders_submitted_plan_check.name: orders_submitted_plan_check
orders_submitted_plan_check.value: "orders"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("orders"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."department_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."needed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."planned_qty" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."planned_price" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."planned_total" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

purchases_cancel_check.name: purchases_cancel_check
purchases_cancel_check.value:
CASE WHEN "purchases"."is_cancelled"
        THEN btrim(coalesce("purchases"."cancel_reason", '')) <> '' AND "purchases"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "purchases"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "purchases"."cancel_reason" IS NULL AND "purchases"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "purchases"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
      END

catalog_suggestions_decision_check.name: catalog_suggestions_decision_check
catalog_suggestions_decision_check.value:
CASE "catalog_suggestions"."status"
        WHEN 'PENDING' THEN "catalog_suggestions"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "catalog_suggestions"."decided_at" IS NULL
          AND "catalog_suggestions"."decision_note" IS NULL AND "catalog_suggestions"."product_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'ADDED' THEN "catalog_suggestions"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_suggestions"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "catalog_suggestions"."product_id" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "catalog_suggestions"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_suggestions"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "catalog_suggestions"."decision_note" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_suggestions"."product_id" IS NULL
      END

audit_log_before_or_after_check.name: audit_log_before_or_after_check
audit_log_before_or_after_check.value: "audit_log"."before" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_log"."after" IS NOT NULL

settings_price_hint_percent_check.name: settings_price_hint_percent_check
settings_price_hint_percent_check.value: key <> 'price_hint_percent' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 END)

settings_overspend_guard_percent_check.name: settings_overspend_guard_percent_check
settings_overspend_guard_percent_check.value: key <> 'overspend_guard_percent' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string' THEN value = '"off"'::jsonb ELSE CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 END END)

settings_reminder_hours_check.name: settings_reminder_hours_check
settings_reminder_hours_check.value: key <> 'reminder_hours' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 720 END)

settings_escalation_hours_check.name: settings_escalation_hours_check
settings_escalation_hours_check.value: key <> 'escalation_hours' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 720 END)

settings_overspend_guard_min_amount_chec.name: settings_overspend_guard_min_amount_check
settings_overspend_guard_min_amount_chec.value: key <> 'overspend_guard_min_amount' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN false ELSE (value #>> '{}') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})$' END)

settings_school_name_check.name: settings_school_name_check
settings_school_name_check.value: key <> 'school_name' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN false WHEN (value #>> '{}') ~ '^[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]$' THEN false ELSE char_length(value #>> '{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 120 END)

settings_school_year_start_check.name: settings_school_year_start_check
settings_school_year_start_check.value: key <> 'school_year_start' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN false WHEN value - 'month' - 'day' <> '{}'::jsonb THEN false WHEN NOT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value -> 'month') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value -> 'month')::numeric <> trunc((value -> 'month')::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value -> 'month')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 12 END THEN false WHEN NOT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value -> 'day') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value -> 'day')::numeric <> trunc((value -> 'day')::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value -> 'day')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 31 END THEN false ELSE (value ->> 'day')::int <= CASE (value ->> 'month')::int WHEN 2 THEN 28 WHEN 4 THEN 30 WHEN 6 THEN 30 WHEN 9 THEN 30 WHEN 11 THEN 30 ELSE 31 END END)

stock_documents_number_check.name: stock_documents_number_check
stock_documents_number_check.value:
"stock_documents"."number" ~ ('^' || CASE "stock_documents"."type"
        WHEN 'ISSUE' THEN 'ISS' WHEN 'RETURN' THEN 'RET' WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN 'TRF'
        WHEN 'WRITE_OFF' THEN 'WOF' WHEN 'COUNT' THEN 'CNT' WHEN 'DIRECT_ENTRY' THEN 'ENT'
      END || '-[A-Z]{2,4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4,}$')

stock_documents_to_branch_check.name: stock_documents_to_branch_check
stock_documents_to_branch_check.value:
("stock_documents"."type" = 'TRANSFER') = ("stock_documents"."to_branch_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND "stock_documents"."to_branch_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "stock_documents"."branch_id"

stock_documents_reason_check.name: stock_documents_reason_check
stock_documents_reason_check.value:
COALESCE(CASE "stock_documents"."type"
        WHEN 'DIRECT_ENTRY' THEN "stock_documents"."reason" IN ('EXISTING_STOCK', 'GIFT', 'OTHER')
        WHEN 'WRITE_OFF' THEN "stock_documents"."reason" IN ('DAMAGED', 'EXPIRED', 'LOST',
          'RETURNED_TO_SUPPLIER', 'LOST_IN_TRANSFER', 'OTHER')
        ELSE "stock_documents"."reason" IS NULL
      END, false)

stock_documents_reversed_check.name: stock_documents_reversed_check
stock_documents_reversed_check.value:
CASE WHEN "stock_documents"."status" = 'REVERSED'
        THEN "stock_documents"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_documents"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(btrim("stock_documents"."reverse_reason"), '') <> ''
        ELSE "stock_documents"."reversed_by" IS NULL AND "stock_documents"."reversed_at" IS NULL
          AND "stock_documents"."reverse_reason" IS NULL
      END

stock_movements_direction_check.name: stock_movements_direction_check
stock_movements_direction_check.value:
CASE
        WHEN "stock_movements"."type" IN ('RECEIPT', 'RETURN', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'DIRECT_ENTRY') THEN "stock_movements"."qty_delta" > 0
        WHEN "stock_movements"."type" IN ('ISSUE', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'WRITE_OFF') THEN "stock_movements"."qty_delta" < 0
        ELSE true
      END
